key_insight: AToP converts Transformer attributions into visit-anchored temporal patterns, revealing combinations and sequences missed by individual-code rankings.
clinical_relevance: The framework helps researchers interpret EHR-based readmission predictions without establishing that highlighted patterns are clinically valid risk factors.
method: Compute per-token Integrated Gradients for a Transformer predicting unplanned 30-day readmission.
Mine frequent temporal patterns from salient tokens and merge near-duplicates by patient overlap.
Compare population-weighted attribution with attribution averaged among patients carrying each token or pattern.
evidence_signal: On MIMIC-IV v3.1 data from 218,196 patients, the Transformer achieved AUROC 0.77 and PR-AUC 0.34; explanations were evaluated using masking, visit-order reversal, token-level faithfulness tests, and KernelSHAP comparison.
watch_item: Pattern attributions reflect model behavior, not unique causal effects or established clinical validity.
paper_title: AToP: An Explainability Framework for Transformer-Based EHR Predictions Using Attribution-Guided Temporal Pattern Mining
